title: StepCheck: Sound Static Verification of Deployed AWS Step Functions Workflows (artifact)
description:
Artifact for the ICSOC 2026 paper StepCheck: Sound Static Verification of Deployed AWS Step Functions Workflows.

StepCheck is a static verifier for the deployed Amazon States Language (ASL) artifact. Its core is a flow-sensitive analysis of the ASL input/output pipeline that reports a missing-field access as an error only when every execution reaching the read would fail under the modeled semantics; seven further checks cover structural, contract, ordering, retry, concurrency, temporal and compensation properties, each graded by the provenance of the facts behind it.

The artifact contains the verifier (Rust), the evaluation corpora, the mutation engine, the execution oracle, the baseline harnesses and the scripts that regenerate the paper's tables, together with a companion technical report giving the formal development and proofs. Third-party workflow provenance and licensing are documented in corpus/PROVENANCE.md.
